# /earth/ — arif-fazil.com Earth Intelligence

## What this is
The Earth organ of the arifOS federation: a live Macrostrat globe, plate boundaries (PB2002), today's earthquakes (USGS), sovereign well portfolio, and geological evidence register. Every number on this page is read from a live data pipe at load time. If a pipe fails, the number is withheld — nothing is invented.

## Key pages
- Interactive globe: https://arif-fazil.com/earth/
- Malay Basin dossier: https://arif-fazil.com/earth/malay-basin/
- Malay Basin cross-section: https://arif-fazil.com/earth/malay-basin-cross-section.html
- Kinabalu Basin dossier: https://arif-fazil.com/earth/kinabalu-basin/
- Kinabalu cross-section: https://arif-fazil.com/earth/kinabalu-cross-section.html

## Data pipes (live at load time)
- Macrostrat API v2: geologic units, columns, lithology (CC-BY 4.0)
- USGS Earthquake Hazards: real-time M2.5+ events, 24h window
- PB2002: 241 plate boundary segments (Bird, 2003)
- Esri World Imagery: satellite reference basemap

## Sovereign canon
- wells.json: https://arif-fazil.com/earth/data/wells.json (sovereign well portfolio)
- studies.json: https://arif-fazil.com/earth/data/studies.json (evidence register)

## Machine surfaces
- surfaces.json: https://arif-fazil.com/surfaces.json (64 surfaces, fail-closed)
- MCP: https://geox.arif-fazil.com/mcp (GEOX organ tools)
- agent.json: https://arif-fazil.com/.well-known/agent.json

## Epistemic
Numbers are claimed only when pipes return data. Ω₀ ≈ 0.04. DITEMPA BUKAN DIBERI.
